---
title: "Session 1 – The case, and the three Rs"
aliases:
  - /tracks/semester/session-1.html
---
The term opens on the case that every later session works on, and on the vocabulary problem that gives the course its name. Reproducibility, robustness and replicability are three different operations, and the paper at the centre of the course was put through all three with three different verdicts.

| Work through | What you do | Timing |
|---|---|---|
| [Case study](../../cases/eu-frames/index.qmd) | The original study, its questions, data and selections; SCORE and the Multi100 project; the five reanalyses and an assessment of their choices; and how Multi100 put their results on one scale. Every later session works on this case. | 60 minutes |
| [Course overview](../../index.qmd) | Read what the exercise is, what the six steps of it are, and what you will need installed. | 15 minutes |
| [Resources – Glossary](../../resources.qmd#glossary) | Learn the difference between reproducibility, robustness and replicability, then read the SCORE dossier table further down the same page, which sets out the three activities that this one paper went through and the outcome of each. | 40 minutes |
| [Exercise overview](../../cases/eu-frames/exercise.qmd) | Read the claim as it was put to the analysts, the coefficient published by the original author (OA), and the table of what five independent analysts found when they reanalysed it. | 45 minutes |

**By the end of the session** you have written one paragraph stating the claim in your own words and naming what the reproduction, the robustness reanalysis and the replication each returned on this paper.
